scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @immortal/server" "npm run dev -w @immortal/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @immortal/shared && npm run build -w @immortal/server && npm run build -w @immortal/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @immortal/shared && npm run typecheck -w @immortal/server && npm run typecheck -w @immortal/client
scripts.storyboard:open: echo Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/storyboard/  after npm run dev   OR   http://127.0.0.1:8765/ART-STORYBOARD-REVIEW.html after npm run storyboard
